items.title: Ramayana: Producer Namit Malhotra Explains How Human Voices Combined With AI Formed English Dubbing
items.excerpt: Ramayana Part 1 was shot only in Hindi. Its English and other international versions use Brahma AI, which combines the human actors' voice work with AI audio and lip-sync so each language version matches the actors' mouth movements. The film opens in theatres and IMAX on November 5.
items.note: Off-list (no allowed-domain coverage found). Brahma face-replacement tech was published earlier via AWN (Jo Plaete); this is a separate story about AI dubbing on a major theatrical release.

items.title: Jujutsu Kaisen studio boss says AI is just "a tool" and real emotion has come from people
items.excerpt: MAPPA president and CEO Manabu Otsuka, whose studio makes Jujutsu Kaisen and Chainsaw Man, says generative AI is nothing more than a tool in anime production and that the emotion audiences respond to comes from human creators. He made the comments amid a growing backlash over AI in the anime industry.
items.note: Off-list (Future plc entertainment desk). Fills the anime-production AI angle; no on-list coverage found.

items.title: A Freshman Year Foundation for AI Filmmaking
items.excerpt: Kevin Geiger, an animation veteran and educator, proposes a first-year AI filmmaking curriculum for art schools that is about 70% traditional foundations and 30% generative practice. He treats prompting as a form of directing and argues that the AI filmmaker is a creator, director, editor and producer, not a 'prompt engineer.'

items.title: ElevenLabs and Mistral Make Voices Speak Any Language
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs' live translation now works in more than 90 languages using a speaker's own voice clone, and Mistral's Voxtral 3 can copy a voice from 30 minutes of audio. Together they make one performer's voice speak dozens of languages, with direct consequences for dubbing and localization work.
items.note: Off-list. Covers the localization/dubbing angle. Weaker fit for film; the curator may prefer to skip it.
